about_block.headline: A Macomb County Concrete Contractor
about_block.body: AGC Concrete is a Southwest Michigan-based concrete contractor serving Macomb County and the surrounding area. Our team specializes in residential and commercial concrete work — driveways, patios, walkways, stamped concrete, garage floors, and foundations — using quality materials and backing every job with our workmanship warranty. We're fully licensed and insured, and we offer financing so a driveway or patio doesn't have to be paid for all at once.
checklist: Free site inspection & estimate before you commit

seo_body.eyebrow: Why Macomb County Homeowners Choose AGC
seo_body.headline: Concrete Contractor Serving Macomb, Clinton Township & Beyond
paragraphs: Michigan's freeze-thaw winters are hard on concrete. Water gets into hairline cracks, freezes, expands, and turns a small crack into a broken slab within a few seasons. AGC Concrete pours and finishes every driveway, patio, and foundation with that in mind — proper base prep, control joints, and quality materials — rather than racing to the next job.

We handle residential and commercial concrete work: driveways, patios and porches, sidewalks and walkways, pool decks, garage floors, and foundations and footings, plus decorative finishes like exposed aggregate, stamped, and colored concrete. Every project starts with a free site inspection and a written estimate, and every project is backed by our workmanship warranty.
If you're comparing quotes, get us out to look at the job first. The inspection is free, and you'll get a real number for your project instead of a rough guess over the phone.

faqs.q: How much does a concrete driveway or patio cost?
faqs.a: It depends on size, site prep, and the finish you choose — plain, exposed aggregate, stamped, or colored. We give you a written estimate after a free, no-obligation site inspection, not a guess over the phone.
Yes. We offer promotional 0% APR financing options so a driveway, patio, or foundation project doesn't have to be paid for all at once. Ask about it when we come out for your estimate.
Yes. AGC Concrete is fully licensed and insured and compliant with all local and state requirements.

faqs.q: What if something goes wrong with my new concrete?
faqs.a: Every project is backed by our workmanship warranty. If something isn't right, we come back and make it right.

faqs.q: How long before I can use my new driveway or patio?
faqs.a: It depends on the mix, the weather, and the finish, so we'll walk you through the cure schedule for your specific project when we finish the pour and tell you exactly when it's ready for use.
We serve Macomb, Clinton Township, Shelby Township, Utica, Washington Township, Sterling Heights, and the surrounding communities within about 30 miles.

faqs.q: Do you do commercial concrete work?
faqs.a: Yes — parking lots, driveways and approaches, sidewalks, curbs and gutters, and foundations for apartments, offices, and commercial buildings, in addition to residential work.
